tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i bsgrub thabs bsdus pa lus kyi dkyil 'khor k+ṣas bskyed pa

bzhugs so// "$ ༄༅// bla ma dam pa rnams dang dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo// dbang bskur ba thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pa spros pa nyung ngu'i rnal 'byor la brtson par 'dod pas/ dben par stan bde ba la rdo rje dkyil krung gis 'dug ste/ oṃ hraḥsarba ma ra sarba a ṭa ra tsa ka kle sha shan tiṃ ka ra badz+ra ri sh+ṇa du kha tshe da/ ma ma ka ra bi sho dha ya swa hā/ zhes pa'am bdud rtsi'i ri lus kha dag par byas te/ lus kyi 'khor lo drug tu rtsa'i grangs dang mnyam pa'i rtse mo/ tshigs chen bcu gnyis su rtse mo sum cu pa/ sor tshigs la bdun pa/ dbang po la rtse gsum/ las kyi dbang po la rtse lnga pa'i rdo rje'i skur bdag nyid bsams te/ me phyogs kyi kha dog can gyi bgegs bsregs la/ yam̐ ram̐ bam̐ lam̐ hūm̐ las rdo rje'i ra ba dang brtsig pa dang 'og tu mdung dang steng du mda'i dra bar gyur par bsam mo// de nas snying kha'i sa bon las 'od 'phros te bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo gsal bar dmigs te/ dri rdo rje ma dang*/ phreng ba ma dang*/ spos ma dang*/ mar me ma dang*/ bdud rtsi ma dang*/ zad med ma dang*/ sgeg ma dang*/ gzhad ma dang*/ sgra ma dang*/ gar ma dang*/ glu ma dang*/ 'dod ma rnams kyis rang rang gi mchod pas mchod de/ rgyal ba kun la phyag 'tshal mchod// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// dge ba kun la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// srid pa'i 'jigs pa 'joms rnams la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par shog /dngos po med pa bsgom pa min// dngos po'ang bsgom par bya ba min// de bzhin dngos dang dngos med min// bsgom pa dmigs su med pa'o// zhes de rnams kyi don dran par bya'o// de nas thams cad rnam thar bzhi'i ngang du bsdu ste/ oṃ shu n+ya ta dz+nya na badz+ra swa bha wā at+ma ko3 ham̐/

oṃ a ni mi ta dz+nya na badz+ra swa bha wā at+ma ko3 ham̐/ oṃ a pra te he ta dz+nya na badz+ra swa bha wā at+ma ko3 ham̐/ oṃ a na bhi sa sa ka ra dz+nya na badz+ra swa bha wā at+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes khams gsum pa'i rdul phra rab kyi chos las 'das par bsgom mo// dang po'i sbyor ba'o// de nas chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi dbus su 'khor lo dang*/ yaṃ las rlung nag po ram̐ las me dmar po/ bam̐ las chu dkar po/ lam̐ las sa ser po/ maṃ las ri rab/ k+ṣaṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma/ ha tsheg drag thig le las zla nyi sgra gcan gyi steng du gzhal yas kyi khang pa rdo rje'i gur dang bcas pa rang gi lus la grub pa ste/ rkang mgo dang byin pa dang*/ brla dang*/ dpyi dang*/ sgal tshigs dang*/ rtsa dang*/ rlung dang*/ thig le dang*/ dbang po'i sgo dang*/ lpags pa dang*/ ba spu'i mthar thug pa yin no// de nas zla nyi sgra gcan bdud dang 'dod lha'i steng du ka li las nyi ma mnyam pa nyid dang*/ a li las zla ba me long lta bu/ hūm̐ so sor rtog pa'i rang bzhin/ hiḥbya ba nan tan/ de las chos dbyings rnam par dag pa haṃ yig sngon por gyur te/ de yang rdo rje rtse lnga pa yongs su gyur pa las dpal dus kyi 'khor lo/ sku 'thing kha/ mgrin pa g.yon dkar g.yas dmar po dbus nag po/ zhal bzhi rtsa ba sngon po khro 'dzum pa/ g.yas dmar po sgeg pa/ g.yon dkar po zhi ba/ rgyab ser po ting nge 'dzin can/ ral pa'i cod pan sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ mthing dmar dkar ba'i dpung pa gsum gsum pa gru mo rnam pa drug drug la phyag mgo nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa/ sor mo rnams ni the bong ser po/ 'dzub mo dkar po/ gung mo dmar po/ srin lag mthing kha/ the'u chung ljang khu/ phyag g.yas rnams rin pa bzhin/ rdo rje ral gri/ rtse gsum/ gri gug /me'i mda'/ lcags kyu/ rnge'u chung*/ tho ba/ 'khor lo/ mdung*/ dbyug pa/ dgra sta'o// g.yon pa rnams kyis dril bu dang*/ phub/ kha ṭ+wām̐ ga /thod khrag

gzhu/ zhags pa/ rin po che/ pad ma dkar po/ dung me long*/ lcags sgrog tshangs pa'i mgo bo bsnams pa'o// zhabs g.yas dmar po brkyang pas 'dod lha dmar po zhal cig phyag bzhi pa g.yas me tog mda' lnga dang*/ lcags kyu/ g.yon gzhu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ dga' mo dang bcas pa mnan pa/ zhabs g.yon dkar po bskum pas drag po zhal bzhi phyag bzhi pa g.yas rtse gsum cang te'u/ g.yon thod pa kha ṭ+wam̐ 'dzin pa u ma dang bcas pa mnan pa'o// rna cha dang mgul rgyan dang dpung rgyan sku regs zhabs gdub dar thod rdo rje'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ thal ba dang mchod phyir thogs dang*/ mi mgo'i phreng ba 'chang ba/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can no// de'i pang na yum sna tshogs ma zhal bzhi phyag brgyad ma gser gyi mdog can/ g.yas dkar g.yon dmar rgyab sngon po/ spyan gsum gsum pa/ g.yas gri gug dang lcags kyu/ ḍa ma ru phreng ba can/ g.yon nya phyis/ zhags pa pad ma dkar po rin po che bsnams pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ bde ba chen pos snyoms par 'jug pa'o// de ltar phyi dang nang du snying khar gsal bar blta ste/ slar yang lha thams cad kyi gnas ni/ rtags kyi lha mo dang bum pa brgyad kyi gnas ni snying kha'i rtsa brgyad do// sangs rgyas dang lha mo'i gnas spyi bo'i rtsa bcu drug go dpral ba ni rdo rje bzhi'o// byang chub sems pa'i gnas mgrin par bcu drug nyis 'gyur ro// gsung gi rnal 'byor ma'i gnas lte ba'i rtsa drug cu rtsa bzhi'o// tsa mun ta la sogs pa brgyad dang*/ la s+yai la sogs pa brgyad kyi gnas gsang ba'i 'khor lo'o// tshigs bcu gnyis kyi re re'ang rtsa sum cu'i bdag nyid can sku'i 'khor lo'o// klu dang gtum mo ni bya ba'i 'khor lo rnams te/ de rnams kyang a ba dhū ti las gyes pa gdugs dang gdugs mgyogs ltar bsgom par bya'o// gnas tshul ni 'dir mi brjod do// de nas spyi bo dang mgrin pa dang snying khar/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang*/ dpral bar ho/ lte bar swa/ gsang bar ha dang bcas pa bkod cing yab kyi gsang ba hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bug bkag pa/ yum gyi mkha' a las pad ma 'dab ma brgyad pa ze'u 'bru la āḥyis mtshan pa bsams te bde ba chen po'i sbyor bas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad zhal du bsdus te/ bde ba'i gnas nas lus la lha thams cad bskyed par bya ste/ sku mdog ni 'khor lo dang 'thun pa'am/ las gang bsgrub pa'i kha dog gam/ mngon rtogs rgyas par bstan pa yang rung ste/ de bzhin du phyag mtshan kyang ye shes kyis rang bzhin gri gug thod khrag can nam/ so so nges pa can gang yang rung bar rgyud 'grel las gsungs so// yang na spyi bor k+ṣu k+ṣu las 'od dpag med dkar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ g.yas nag g.yon dmar/ dbus dkar g.yas na tho ba mdung dang rtse gsum pa/ g.yon pad zla me long phreng ba can/ ma ma ki dang bcas pa'o/ dpral bar k+ṣa k+ṣaṃ las mi bskyod pa ljang khu/ g.yas rdo rje gri gug dgra sta/ g.yon dril bu thod pa tshangs pa'i mgo bo yum rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma dang bcas pa'o// mgrin par k+shī k+shī las rin chen 'byung ldan dmar po g.yas dkar g.yon nag pa/ phyag g.yas me'i mda' dang lcags kyu cang te'u/ g.yon gzhu dang zhags pa nor bu/ yum gos dkar mo dang bcas pa'o// snying khar k+ṣe k+ṣe las don yod grub pa nag po g.yas dmar g.yon dkar ba/ phyag g.yas ral gri gri gug rtse gsum/ g.yon phub thod pa kha ṭ+wām̐ ga yum sgrol ma dang bcas pa'o// lte bar k+ṣ+li k+ṣ+li las rnam par snang mdzad ser po g.yas dkar g.yon nag pa/ phyag g.yas 'khor lo dbyug pa rdo rje/ g.yon dung lcags sgrog dril bu/ yum spyan ma dang bcas pa'o// gsang bar k+shaḥk+shaḥlas rdo rje sems dpa' sngon po mi bskyod pa dang*/ mthun pa sna tshogs yum dang bcas pa'o// de rnams kyi thugs khar u a ri i li aṃ spyi bo nas rim par dgod do// de bzhin du lha gzhan thams cad kyang shes par bya ste/

'grel par k+ṣa la dbyangs kyis bsgyur ba ye shes kyi sa bon zhes bya ba'i don no/ de nas khro bo chen po rdo rje'i shugs rang lta bu la phyag lhag ma gnyis kyi glang po'i lpags pa bsnams pa sbrul brgyad dang thod pas brgyan pa spros la/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad bkug la/ dza hūm̐ baṃ ho hiḥzhes dgug gzhug bcing mgu mchog tu bya'o// de dang dus gcig tu spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par aḥ snying khar hūm̐/ dkar dmar sngo ba las 'od 'phros te/ rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin du byas te/ dbang bskur zhing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ka yā wāka tsit+ta badz+ra swā bha wā at+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes rgyas gdab par bya'o// de dang dus gcig tu sems can thams cad kyang 'od zer gyis dbang bskur te/ lha'i rang bzhin du bsgom par bya'o// de nas mchod pa'i lha mo dang*/ 'dod ma dang mi 'dod ma rnams kyis mchod cing bstod par mos te mnyam par bzhag go /de nas thun mong bsgrub pa'i phyir bzlas pa byed na/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs kha'i sa bon las so so dang mthun pa'i spro bsdu bya zhing*/ oṃ haṃ hrī hrīṃ hrum̐ h+lam̐ḥhraṃḥzhes pa dang*/ oṃ a hūm̐ ho phaṭa swā hā zhes bzlas so// rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni/ dbu ma'i mar snar gtum mo ho'i rnam pa la dmigs te bsgom pa rtsa ba'i rgyud du gsungs pa 'di lta ste/ bha gar ling ga rab bzhag nas// byang chub sems ni btang mi bya// khams ma lus pa rnams la ni// sangs rgyas sku ru bsgom par bya// lte bar gtum mo spar ba yis// de bzhin gshegs pa lnga bsregs nas// spyan ma mig la sogs pa yang*// bsregs pas haṃ las ri bong can// 'dzags pa thig le'i gzugs su ni// bdud rtsi khu ba yi ni chos// thig le'i rnal 'byor zhes su grags// bcu drug phyed phyed thig le can// dus med dus las 'das pa ste// bsam gtan bzhi yi rtse mo 'chang*// phra mo'i rnal 'byor zhes su grags// rgyu mthun la sogs steng du song*// dung can phyag rgya chen po la// gtum mo yang ni rab tu brjod// gang gis lte steng g.yung mo ni// kun dhar ma ni sna rtse ru// 'od zer lnga yi rang bzhin dbugs// dkyil 'khor lngar yang 'byung ba yis// sna yi rtse mo'i yungs dkar brjod// srog rtsol rgyu ba ru ni dran// khams gsum ma lus pa ru ni// srid gsum yongs su shes pa yis// srog ni bkag pa de yis kyang*// rgyu dang mi rgyu yungs dkar tsam// so sor bsdud pa phyag rgya che// nam mkha' stong pa'i mtshan nyid du// sna rtse de yi phyogs su yang*// gang du yid ni rab gtad pa// mtshan ma mtha' ru ri mo gang*// de ru sna tshogs rgyu mi rgyu// rnal 'byor bsam gtan la sogs kyang*// ma lus pa nyid de ru bsgoms// zhes gsungs pas bsgom par bya'o// spyod lam rnam pa bzhi thams cad de nyid kyi nga rgyal gyis bya'o// lha rnams bsdu ba ni rang gi lus rdo rje'i rang bzhin la bsdu'o// dus kyi 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs bsdus pa 'di// spros nyung rnams la phan phyir rgyud 'grel dang*/
mthun par rang byung ming can gyis bris so// dge bas rdo rje 'chang gi sa thob shog// /
